from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({D}), scl=Pin({C}))
A = 0x70
DIG = [0x3F, 0x06, 0x5B, 0x4F, 0x66, 0x6D, 0x7D, 0x07, 0x7F, 0x6F]
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x21')
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x81')
i2c.writeto(A, b'\xEF')
ram = bytearray(16)
for pos, d in zip((0, 2, 6, 8), (1, 2, 3, 4)):
    ram[pos] = DIG[d]
i2c.writeto(A, b'\x00' + ram)
while True:
    time.sleep(1)
